sources.summary: The construction of the new pavilion is part of a larger urban project to reclaim and enhance a large green space called PARCOBROLO, which extends to the southern part of the town of Bonate Sotto in the Villa district, covering an area of over 30,000 square meters. This large orchard (brolo) has survived over time, untouched by the expansion of the surrounding buildings.
